T0583.title: Cache Poisoning
T0583.definition: An attack that causes a cache to store and serve attacker-controlled or incorrect content.
T0583.description: Cache poisoning causes a cache to store attacker-controlled or incorrect responses and serve them to later users. It often exploits incomplete cache keys, header parsing differences, or proxy-chain inconsistencies. Defenses require clear cacheable scope, request normalization, isolation of user-specific content, and monitoring of abnormal cache hits.
T0583.usageExample: Assess Cache Poisoning related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
